Libraries
```{r}

#for mefisto
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")


library(ggplot2)
library(svdx)
library(svdxBenchmark)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
```


```{r load-raw}
tc2 <- readRDS( file="PD1_time_course_6_pseudobulk.rds" )
tc2$xdata$treatment <- factor(tc2$xdata$treatment, levels=c("Control", "Anti-PD1"))
tc2$xda$tissue <- factor(tc2$xdata$tissue) #only one 
tc2$xdata$cell_type #only one

fd <- data.frame( id = rownames(tc2$counts), symbol = rownames(tc2$counts) )
rownames(fd) <- rownames(tc2$counts)
tc2$xdata <- as.data.frame(tc2$xdata)
rownames(tc2$xdata) <- colnames(tc2$counts)

es <- ExpressionSet( assayData = as.matrix(tc2$counts), 
                     phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame( tc2$xdata ), 
                     featureData = AnnotatedDataFrame( fd )
                     )

fdata <- fData(es)
Y_raw <- exprs(es)
xdata <- pData(es)
xdata$treatment_tissue <- paste0( xdata$treatment, "_", xdata$tissue )

zdata <- xdata


```

# Define SVDX formulas
```{r formulas}
xformula = ~treatment*tissue*day
zformula = ~1 

```

# Optional inputs
```{r optional-inputs}
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(es))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(es))
tj <- colSums( exprs(es) ); tj <- tj/exp(mean(log(tj)))


mice <- unique(xdata$mouse)
test_n <- c(
  "1_Control" = 1,
  "2_Control" = 1,
  "2_Anti-PD1" = 0,
  "3_Control" = 0,
  "3_Anti-PD1" = 1,
  "4_Control" = 1,
  "4_Anti-PD1" = 1,
  "5_Control" = 1,
  "5_Anti-PD1" = 1,
  "6_Control" = 1,
  "6_Anti-PD1" = 1
)

mouse_meta <- xdata |>
  distinct(mouse, day, treatment) |>
  mutate(stratum = paste(day, treatment, sep = "_"))

set.seed(1)
test_mice <- unlist(
  lapply(names(test_n), function(s) {
    mice <- mouse_meta$mouse[mouse_meta$stratum == s]
    sample(mice, size = test_n[s])
  })
)

xdata$split <- ifelse(
  xdata$mouse %in% test_mice,
  "test",
  "train"
)

xdata |>
  distinct(mouse, day, treatment, split) |>
  count(day, treatment, split)
```

# Preprocess

```{r preprocess}
fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "id", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "symbol", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "symbol" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)

prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_raw,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = TRUE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = tj,
  normalize = TRUE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = col_offsets,
  row_offset = row_offsets,
  dataset_name = "antipd1"
)
```



#benchmark
```{r}
METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  "mefisto_duplicate_view",
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)

rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 
  
  train_cols = which( prepared$xdata$split == "train" ),
  
  K = 15, 

  methods = METHODS, 
  spca_keepX_grid = SPCA_KEEPX_GRID,
  sparse_nmf_lambda_grid = SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID,
  mefisto_covariates = "day",
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), 
  
  ftol_abs = 1e-5, 
  
  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = NULL,
  enrichment_backend = "internal",
  msigdb_db_species = "MM", 
  msigdb_species = "Mus musculus", 
  msigdb_collection = "M5", 
  msigdb_subcollection = "BP"
)

rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports(rw_single = rw_single, 
                                    outdir = "./antipd1_tc6", overwrite=T, 
                                 color="treatment_tissue", group="treatment_tissue", line_group = "treatment_tissue",
                                xaxis="day", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T, 
                                    enrichment_top_n = 25, 
                                svdx_report_args = list( z_adjustment = "fitted", 
                                                         heatmap_order_by = c("treatment", "tissue",  "day"), 
                                                         feature_profile_show_se = T , 
                                                         feature_profile_color = "treatment", 
                                                         feature_profile_facet = "tissue", 
                                                         feature_profiles_top_n = 1L,
                                                         x ="day"
                                                         )
                                 )




```

outs <- make_single_benchmark_supplement(

  dataset_title = "time course 6 of anti-PD1 OT1 study. Samples collected at day 1 were available only from control animals, whereas both control and anti-PD-1-treated animals were observed from day 2 onward. The general SSANOVA-SVD representation without imposing experiment-specific structure at treatment initiation. So fitted anti-PD-1 component functions at day 1 are extrapolated. The figures include components, their decompositions, volcano plots for feature associations, and heatmaps of top 50 component-associated features at FDR of 10%",

  ),

)
